#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <cassert>
#include <complex>
#include <bitset>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;

ll binPow(ll base, int exp, int mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k, p;
    cin >> n >> k >> p;
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        cout << binPow(k, n, p) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<ll> fact(n + 1, 1), inv_fact(n + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p;
    }
    inv_fact[n] = binPow(fact[n], p - 2, p);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p;
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> g(n + 1, vector<ll>(17, 0));
    g[0][0] = 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    function<void(int, vector<int>, int, int)> solve = [&](int n, vector<int> bits, int k, int mask) {
        if (k == (int)bits.size()) {
            ++cnt;
            for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
                g[n][i] += inv_fact[mask] * g[n ^ mask][i - 1];
                if (cnt >= 8) g[n][i] %= p;
            }
            if (cnt >= 8) cnt = 0;
            return;
        }
        solve(n, bits, k + 1, mask);
        solve(n, bits, k + 1, mask ^ (1 << bits[k]));
    };
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if ((i & n) != i) continue;
        vector<int> bits;
        for (int j = 0; j < 18; ++j) {
            if ((1 << j) & i) bits.push_back(j);
        }
        solve(i, bits, 1, 1 << bits[0]);
    }
    ll answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(16, k); ++i) {
        g[n][i] %= p;
        ll temp = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p;
        temp = temp * fact[k] % p;
        temp = temp * inv_fact[k - i] % p;
        answer = (answer + temp) % p;
    }
    ll total = binPow(k, n, p);
    answer = total - answer;
    if (answer < 0) answer += p;
    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
